description: Extract the core message, key points and structure from a URL, pasted text (50-20,000 characters) or Markdown, without generating any variants — a preview of what repurpose_content would work from. Counts against the monthly repurpose limit and uses one AI text action, so prefer repurpose_content when the user wants variants anyway.

type.description: What kind of source: a URL, plain text, or Markdown (docforge).

name: parse_content_source
